text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al- Abdulla al-Sabah improving. Sheikh Saad flew to London on Monday for follow up treatment after a colon surgery in Kuwait.
- Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) forms a company to finance up to 50 percent of small projects with a maximum limit of 250,000 ($825,000) dinars.
- Kuwait's Public Industrial Authority to host seminar on the importance of coordination among Gulf Arab states.
- Trade and Industry Ministry is preparing a law to regulate foreign investments in Kuwait.
- Kuwait's economists society to hold conference on budget deficit in April
- Kuwait University to introduce new pay scale for teaching staff, rector says.
- Kuwait-Morocco start financial talks. Moroccan Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj arrived in Kuwait on Friday.
